Trusted Apple Vision Pro Repair Center in Bangladesh

The Apple Vision Pro opens a new world of immersive experiences, from spatial videos to seamless multitasking in a limitless digital workspace. Yet even minor issues, a cracked front glass, sudden battery drain, or faulty eye-tracking. These issues can disrupt this experience entirely. For users in Bangladesh, where no trusted Apple Care exists, these problems are especially challenging. Shipping devices abroad brings long delays and high costs, leaving many without timely solutions. Recognizing this need, iFixit BD launched Bangladesh’s first dedicated Apple Vision Pro repair service. With advanced tools and skilled technicians, the service provides fast, reliable, and affordable repairs. From screen and battery replacements to hardware and tracking fixes, iFixit BD ensures devices are restored to peak performance. By offering local expertise and professional support, iFixit BD empowers Vision Pro users in Dhaka and across Bangladesh to return to their immersive digital world without interruption, combining efficiency, reliability, and peace of mind.

Our Apple Vision Pro Repair Services

Visual clarity and precise tracking are essential for an optimal user experience. Issues like distortion or sensor glitches can significantly affect performance.

Our Apple Vision Pro repair services include:

  • Apple Vision Pro optical issues repair (glare, color fringing, distortion),
  • Apple Vision Pro technical glitches repair (hand tracking, eye tracking in low light)

Our expert team ensures your device functions at its best. We deliver fast, reliable, and professional service every time. Enjoy a seamless and flawless experience with your device restored to peak performance.
